name: m2a2_battle_bridge
_comment: M2a.2 theater board: three zones (arrival room with DP-A + item, corridor between the two doors, terminal room with terminal + escape). Doors start closed; scripts open them to generate the public door_opened belief event. Impassable wall column keeps LOS (IA rule) but cuts movement, so the corridor doors are the geographic contest points the doctrine text names ('Tuer A/B'). Hero entrances are public mission setup, passed per scenario.
